G2100.def:
εὐαρεστέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for הָלַךְ hith., Gn 5:22, 24, Sl 26:2 56:13, al., Sir.44:16 ;]
to be well pleasing: τ. θεῷ (LXX, ll. with), Hb 11:5-6. Pass., to be well pleased: with dative, Hb 13:16.†
(AS)

G2101.def:
εὐ-άρεστος, -ον
[in LXX: Wis.4:10 9:10 * ;]
well-pleasing, acceptable: Rm 12:2; with dative of person(s), Rm 12:1 14:16, 2Co 5:9, Ef 5:10, Fp 4:18; id. before ἐν, Tt 2:9 (κυρίῳ), Cl 3:20; ἐνώπιον, Hb 13:21 (for ex. in Inser., see Deiss., BS, 215).†
(AS)

G2104.def:
εὐγενής, -ές
(εὖ, γένος), [in LXX: Jó 1:3 (גָּדוֹל), 2Ma.10:13 R, 4Ma.6:5 4Mac 9:13 4Mac 9:23 4Mac 9:27 4Mac 10:3 4Mac 10:15 * ;]
__1. well born, of noble race: Lc 19:12, 1Co 1:26.
__2. noble-minded: compar., -έστερος, At 17:11.†
(AS)

G2105.def:
εὐδία, -ας, ἡ
(εὔδιος, calm) [in LXX: Sir.3:15 * ;]
fair weather: Mt 16:2 (Rec., R, txt.).†
(AS)

G2106.def:
εὐ-δοκέω, -ῶ
(on the derivation, see EL, § 28, 6) [in LXX chiefly for רָצָה, also for אָבָה, חָפֵץ, etc. ;]
__1. with inf. (Polyb., al.), to be well pleased, to think it good, to give consent (so frequently in π. in legal docu­ments; Milligan, Th., 22 f.): Lc 12:32, Rm 15:26-27, 1Co 1:21, Gl 1:15, Cl 1:19, R, mg. (ICC, in l, but see infr.), 1Ts 2:8 3:1; μᾶλλον εὐ., 2Co 5:8; with accusative and inf. (Polyb., i, 8, 4), Col, l.with, R, txt. (Lft., in l).
__2. to be well pleased or take pleasure with or in a person or thing;
__(a) with dative (Polyb., al.; 1Ma.1:43, I Et 4:39): 2Ts 2:12;
__(b) as frequently in LXX,
__α with accusative: Mt 12:13, Hb 10:5, 8" (LXX) ;
__β before ἐν (cf. Heb. בּ רָצָה, Sl 149:4): Mt 3:17 17:5, Mc 1:11, Lc 3:22 (on the tense, see M, Pr., 134 f.; DCG, i,308 b), 1Co 10:5, 2Co 12:10, Hb 10:38" (LXX) ;
__(with) before εἰς: 2Pe 1:17. (cf. συν-ευδοκέω, and see Cremer, 213 f.; Field, Notes, 48 f.; DCG, i, 355a.)†
(AS)

G2107.def:
εὐδοκία, -ας, ἡ
(εὐδοκέω, which see), [in LXX: Sl 5:12, al. (רָצוֹן), frequently in Sir; in Inscr. (I.G., 5960), LXX, and NT = εὐδόκησις (Died.) ;]
good pleasure, good-will, satisfaction, approval: Mt 11:26, Lc 10:21, Rm 10:1, Ef 1:5, 9, Fp 1:15 2:13; with genitive obj., 2Ts 1:11 (see Milligan, in l); ἐν ἀνθρώποις εὐδοκία, Rec., R, mg., WH, mg. (see Field, Notes, 48 f.), Lc 2:14; -ας, Lk, l.with, R, txt., WH, txt. (see ICC, in l; WH, App., in l).†
(AS)

G2108.def:
εὐεργεσία, -ας, ἡ
(εὐεργέτης), [in LXX: Sl 78:11 (עֲלִילָה), Wis.16:11, 24, 2Ma.6:13 2Mac 9:26, 4Ma.8:17 * ;]
a good deed, kindness, benefit: 1Tm 6:2; with genitive of person(s) (εὐ. πόλεως, Plat., leg., 805b), At 4:9,†
(AS)

G2109.def:
εὐεργετέω, -ῶ
(εὐεργέτης), [in LXX: Sl 13:6 (גָּמַל), Wis.3:5, al. ;]
to do good, bestow benefit: At 10:33.†
(AS)

G2110.def:
εὐεργέτης, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Et 8:13, Wis.19:14, 2Ma.4:2, 3Ma.3:19 3Mac 6:24 * ;]
a benefactor: Lc 22:25 (for contemp. usage, see Deiss., LAE, 248).†
(AS)

G2111.def:
εὔ-θετος, -ον
(τίθημι), [in LXX: Sl 32:6 (מָצָא), From Th Sus 1:15* ;]
ready for use, fit: of things, with dative, Hb 6:7; before εἰς, Lc 14:35; of persons, with dative, Lc 9:62 (for rabbinic parallels, see Dalman, Words, 119 f.).†
(AS)

G2112.def:
εὐθέως
adv. (εὐθύς), [in LXX: Jó 5:3 (פִּתְאוֹם), Wis.5:12, 1Ma.11:12, al. ;]
straightway, at once, directly: Gl 1:16, Tg 1:24, 3Jn.14 (cf. Dalman, Words, 28 f.), Ap 4:2, and frequently in Mt, Lk, Jo, Ac (in Mk, εὐθύς), which see)
(AS)

G2113.def:
εὐθυδρομέω, -ῶ
of ships, to run a straight course (Philo): At 16:11 21:1.†
(AS)

G2114.def:
εὐθυμέω, -ῶ
(ὔθυμος), [in Sm.: Sl 32:11, Pv 15:15 * ;]
__1. trans., to make cheerful (Æsch.).
__2. Intrans. (Eur., Plut.; so mid. in Xen., Plat.), to be of good cheer: At 27:22, 25, Tg 5:13.†
(AS)

G2115.def:
εὔ-θυμος, -ον
[in LXX: 2Ma.11:26 * ;]
__1. kind (Hom.).
__2. of good cheer (Æsch., al.): At 27:36.†
(AS)

G2116.def:
εὐθύνω
(εὐθύς), [in LXX: Nm 22:23, Js 24:23 (נָטָה hi.), Jz 14:7, 1Rs 18:20 18:26 (יָשַׁר) Pv 20:24, Sir.2:2, 6, al. ;]
__1. to direct: Tg 3:4.
__2. to make straight: Jo 1:23 (LXX, ἑτοιμάσατε).†
(AS)

G2117.def:
εὐθύς, -εῖα, -ύ
[in LXX chiefly for יָשַׁר ;]
__1. straight, direct: τρίβοι, Mt 3:3, Mc 1:3, Lc 3:4" (LXX) ; εἰς εὐθειας, (sc. ὁδούς), Lc 3:5; εὐ. ὐδός, figuratively, At 13:10, 2Pe 2:15; as (Proper name) of a street, At 9:11.
__2. In moral sense, straightforward, right: καρδία, At 8:21 (cf. Sl 7:11 32:11, al.).†
εὐθύς,
adv., [in LXX (more frequently than εὐθέως) chiefly for יָשַׁר ;]
= εὐθέως, straightway, directly: Mt 3:16 13:20-21 14:27 21:2-3 26:74, Lc 6:49, Jo 13:30, 32 19:34, At 10:16, 42 times in Mk.†
(AS)

G2118.def:
εὐθύτης, -ητος, ἡ
(εὐθύς), [in LXX chiefly for יֹשֶׁר, מִישׁוֹר and cognate forms ;]
uprightness: Hb 1:8 (LXX).†
(AS)

G2119.def:
εὐκαιρέω, -ῶ
(= cl., εὖ σχολῆς ἔχειν; used by Polyb. and Philo; cf. Rutherford, NPhr. 205; MM, Exp., xiv),
to have leisure or opportunity: 1Co 16:12; with inf., Mc 6:31; before εἰς, to devote one's leisure to, At 17:21.†
(AS)

G2120.def:
εὐκαιρία, -ας, ἡ
(εὔκαιρος), [in LXX: Sl 9:10 (see Soph., Lex., see word) Sl 10:1 145:15 (עֵת), Sir.38:24, 1Ma.11:42 * ;]
fitting time, opportunity: before ἵνα, Mt 26:16; τοῦ, with inf., Lc 22:6.†
(AS)

G2121.def:
εὔ-καιρος, -ον
[in LXX: Sl 104:27 (עֵת), 2Ma.14:29 2Mac 15:20-21, 3Ma.4:11 3Mac 5:44 * ;]
timely, seasonable, suitable (Cremer, 740): ἡμέρα, Mc 6:21 (or empty, as in Byz. and MGr.; see MM, Exp., xiv); βοήθεια, Hb 4:16.†
(AS)

G2122.def:
εὐκαίρως
adv., [in LXX: Sir.18:22 * ;]
seasonably, in season: Mc 14:11; opposite to ἀκ- (Kühner3, iv, 346 d), 2Tm 4:2.†
(AS)

G2123.def:
εὔ-κοπος, -ον
[in LXX: Sir.22:15, 1Ma.3:18 * ;]
with easy labour, easy: compar., -ώτερόν ἐστι, with inf., Mt 9:5, Mc 2:9, Lc 5:23; with accusative and inf., Mt 19:24, Mc 10:25, Lc 16:17 18:25 (Polyb.; the adv. -ως occurs in Aristoph., Fr., 615).†
(AS)

G2124.def:
εὐλάβεια, -ας, ἡ
(εὐλαβής), [in LXX: Jr 22:24 (דְּאָגָה), Pv 28:14, Wis.17:8 * ;]
__1. caution, discretion (Soph., Plat., al.).
__2. In later Gk. (Diod., Plut., al.), also reverence, godly fear: Hb 5:7 12:28.†
(AS)

G2125.def:
εὐλαβέομαι, -οῦμαι
[in LXX: Pv 30:5, Na 1:7 (חָסָה), al., for 15 different Heb. words in all; also Sir.7:29 41:3, al. ;]
__1. to be cautious, to beware: At 23:10 (Rec.; φοβηθείς, WH, RV).
__2. to reverence: Hb 11:7 (cf. Cremer, 388).†
(AS)

G2126.def:
εὐλαβής, -ές
(εὖ, λαβεῖν), [in LXX: Mq 7:2 AB2 (חָסִיד); εὐ. ποιεῖν, Lv 15:31 (נָזַר hi.), Sir.11:7 א2* ;]
__1. cautious, circumspect.
__2. devout, religious, reverent: At 2:5 8:2 22:12; δίκαιος καὶ εὐ., Lc 2:25.†
(AS)

G2127.def:
εὐλογέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for בָּרַךְ pi. ;]
__1. to speak well of, praise (cl.; LXX Dt 8:10, al.): τ. θεόν, Lc 1:64 2:28 24:51, 53 (αἰνοῦντες, T, WH, mg.), Tg 3:9; absol., to give praise, Mt 14:19 26:26 (see Swete on Mc 14:22), Mc 6:41 14:22 (see Swete, in l), Lc 24:30, 1Co 14:16.
__2. As in LXX (= בָּרַךְ pi.);
__(a) to bless, invoke blessings on (Gn 24:60, Nm 23:20, al.): absol., 1Co 4:12, 1Pe 3:9; with accusative of person(s), Lc 2:34 6:28 24:50-51, Rm 12:14, Hb 7:1, 6-7 11:20-21; εὐλογημένος (= בָּרַךְ; see Lft., Notes, 310; DCG, i, 189), blessed, Mt 21:9 23:39" (LXX), Mc 11:9-10, Lc 13:35 19:38" (LXX), Jo 12:13; with accusative of thing(s), Mc 8:7, Lc 9:16, 1Co 10:16;
__(b) with God as subject (Sl 44:3, al.), to bless, prosper, bestow blessings on: with accusative of person(s), At 3:26, Gl 3:9, Ef 1:3 (Lft., Notes, 311), Hb 6:14; εὐλογημένος, Lc 1:28 (WH, tit., R, tit., omit) Lc 1:42; εὐλογημένοι τ. πατρός (cf. Is 61:9), Mt 25:34; pass. At 3:25 (cf. ἐν-, κατ-ευλογέω).†
SYN.: see: αἰνέω, and cf. DCG, i, 189, 211; Cremer, 766 (AS)

G2128.def:
εὐλογητός, -όν
(εὐλογέω), [in LXX chiefly for בָּרַךְ ;]
blessed;
__(a) of men (Gn 12:2 A, Dt 7:14, Jz 17:2 B, Rt 2:20, 1Rs 15:13);
__(b) of God (Lft., Notes, 310 f.), as chiefly in LXX (Gn 9:26, Êx 17:10, Sl 18:46, al.): Lc 1:68, Rm 1:25 9:5 (ICC, in l), 2Co 1:3 11:31, Ef 1:3, 1Pe 1:3; absol., ὁ εὐλογητός (Dalman, Words, 200; JThS, v, 453), Mc 14:61 (Cremer, 769).†
(AS)

G2129.def:
εὐλογία, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for בְּרָכָה ;]
__1. fair speaking, flattering speech: χρηστολογίας καὶ εὐ., Rm 16:18.
__2. praise: of God (as in late Inscr.; LS, see word) and Christ, Ap 5:12-13 7:12
__3. In LXX and NT: blessing, benediction;
__(a) the act of blessing: 1Co 10:16, Hb 12:17, Tg 3:10;
__(b) concrete, a blessing: Rm 15:29, 2Co 9:5-6, Gl 3:14, Ef 1:3, Hb 6:7, 1Pe 3:9 (cf. Dt 11:26, Sir.7:32, al.).†
(AS)

G2130.def:
εὐ-μετά-δοτος, -ον
(εὖ, μεταδιδωμι),
ready to impart: assoc. with κοινωνικός (for the distinction between the two, see Field, Notes, 213; CGT, in l), 1Tm 6:18.†
(AS)

G2132.def:
εὐ-νοέω, -ῶ
(εὔνοος, friendly), [in LXX: Et 8:13 Bא1, Dan LXX 2:43, 3Ma.7:11 * ;]
to be favourable, kindly disposed: with dative, Mt 5:25.†
(AS)

G2133.def:
εὔνοια, -ας, ἡ
(εὔνοος), [in LXX: Et 2:23, al. ;]
goodwill: Ef 6:7 (of slaves; cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†
(AS)

G2134.def:
εὐνουχίζω
(εὐνοῦχος),
to make a eunuch of, castrate: pass., Mt 19:12; metaphorically, εὐ. έαυτόν, ib.†
(AS)

G2135.def:
εὐνοῦχος, -ου, ὁ
(i.e. ὁ τὴν εὐνὴν(bed) ἔχων), [in LXX for סָרִיס (perhaps not of necessity an actual eunuch; DB, see word), Gn 39:1, al., Wis.3:14, Sir.20:4 30:20 ;]
an emasculated man, a eunuch: Mt 19:12; one such holding, as was common, high office, as of chamberlain, at court, At 8:27, 34-39; metaphorically, of one naturally incapacitated for or volun­tarily abstaining from wedlock, Mt 19:12.†
(AS)

G2136.def:
Εὐοδία (Rec. -ωδία), -ας, ἡ
Euodia (not as AV, Euodias), a Christian woman: Fp 4:2.†
(AS)

G2137.def:
εὐ-οδόω, -ῶ
(ὁδός), [in LXX chiefly for צָלַח hi. ;]
to help on one's way (Soph., al.). Pass., to have a prosperous journey; metaphorically (Hdt., al.), to prosper, be prospered, be successful: 3Jn.2, Rm 1:10, 1Co 16:2 (on the tense, see M, Pr., 54; ICC, in l).†
(AS)

G2138.def:
εὐ-πειθής, ές,
(εὖ, πείθομαι), [in LXX: 4Ma.12:6 AR* ;]
ready to obey, compliant: Tg 3:17.†
(AS)

G2139.def:
εὐ-περί-στατος, -ον
(εὖ, περιΐστημι),
of sins, readily besetting: Hb 12:1 (on form and sense of the word, see Westc., in l).†
(AS)

G2140.def:
εὐ-ποιία (Rec. -ιΐα), -ας, ἡ
__1. beneficence, doing good: Hb 13:16.
__2. a benefit (FlJ, Ant., ii, ll, 2, al.).†
(AS)

G2141.def:
εὐ-πορέω, -ῶ
(εὔτορος, well provided for) [in LXX: Lv 25:26, 49 נָשַׂג hi.), Lv 25:23 (seel.), Wis.10:10 * ;]
to prosper, be well off: At 11:29.†
(AS)

G2142.def:
εὐ-πορία, -ας, ἡ
(εὔπορος), [in LXX for חַיִל, 4Ki.25:10 A (frequently in Aq.)* ;]
__1. facility.
__2. plenty, wealth: At 19:25.†
(AS)

G2143.def:
εὐ-πρέπεια, -ας, ἡ
(εὐπρεπής, comely), [in LXX for הָדָר, etc. ;]
goodly appearance, comeliness: Tg 1:11.†
(AS)

G2144.def:
εὐ-πρόσ-δεκτος, -ον
(εὖ, προσδέχομαι)
more usual than δέκτος, which see, acceptable: Rm 15:16, 31, 2Co 6:2 8:12, 1Pe 2:5.†
(AS)

G2146.def:
εὐ-προσωπέω, -ῶ
(εὐπρόσωπος, fair of face), [in Al.: Sl 141:6, seel. for -ίζω* ;]
to look well, make a fair show: metaphorically (as in 7.; see Deiss., LAE, 96), Gl 6:12.†
(AS)

G2147.def:
εὑρίσκω,
[in LXX chiefly for מצא, also for נשׂג hi., etc. ;]
to find, with or without previous search: absol., opposite to ζητέω, Mt 7:7, 8 Lc 11:9, 10; with accusative, Mt 2:8, Mc 1:37, At 13:22, 2Tm 1:17, al.; pass., οὐχ εὑ., of disappearance, Hb 11:5, Ap 16:20, al.; γῆ κ. τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ ἔργα εὑρεθήσεται (for conjectures as to the meaning of this reading, see Mayor, ICC, in l.), 2Pe 3:10, WH, R, mg. Metaphorical, to find, find out by inquiry, learn, discover: Lc 19:48, At 4:21; αἰτίαν, Jo 18:38, At 13:28, al.; pass., Mt 1:18, Lc 17:18, Rm 7:10, 1Co 4:2, Gl 2:17, 1Pe 1:7, Ap 5:4, al.; of attaining to the knowledge of God, εὑ. θεόν, At 17:27; pass., Rm 10:20 (LXX). Mid., to find for oneself, gain, procure, obtain: with accusative of thing(s), λύτρωσιν, Hb 9:12; act. in same sense (so cl. poets, but not in Attic prose), Mt 10:39 11:29, Lc 1:30, At 7:46, 2Tm 1:18, al. (cf. ἀν-ευρίσκω).
(AS)

G2148.def:
Εὐρ-ακύλων (Rec. εὐροκλύδων, which see), -ωνος
(Εὖρος, the East wind, and Lat. Aquilo; Vg., Euroaquilo),
the Euraquilo, a N.E. wind (i.e. between Eurus and Aquilo): At 27:14.†
εὐρο-κλύδων (G, εὐροκλ-), -ωνος, ὁ
(Εὖρος (seel. εὐρύς, broad), κλύδων),
Euroclydon (prob. a sailor's corruption of Εὐρακύλων, which see): At 17:14, Rec,†
(AS)

G2149.def:
εὐρύ-χωρος, -ον
(εὐρύς, broad + χώρα), [in LXX for רָחַב ni., and cognate forms (Is 30:23, al.), exc. 2Cr 18:9 (גֹּרֶן ;)
spacious, broad: Mt 7:13.†
(AS)

G2150.def:
εὐ-σέβεια, -ας, ἡ
(εὐσεβής, which see), [in LXX: Pv 1:7, Is 33:6 (יִרְאָה), Pv 13:11 (aliter in Heb.), Is 11:2 (יְהוָֹה יִרְאָה), I Et 1:23, Wis.10:12, Sir.49:3, and very frequently in 4Mac ;]
__1. piety, reverence (towards parents and others).
__2. piety towards God, godliness: At 3:12, 1Tm 2:2 4:7-8 6:5-6 6:11, 2Pe 1:3 1:6-7; τὸ τῆς εὐ. μυστήριον, 1Tm 3:16; ἡ κατ᾽ εὐ. διδασκαλία, 1Tm 6:3; ἡ ἀλήθεια ἡ κατ᾽ εὐ., Tt 1:1; μόρφωσις εὐσεβείας, 2Tm 3:5; pl. (see Bl., § 32, 6; Mayor on Tg 2:1), 2Pe 3:11 (on the use of εὐ. and cognates in Past. Epp., see CGT, on 1Tm 2:2; cf. also Cremer, 524).†
(AS)

G2151.def:
εὐ-σεβέω, -ῶ
(εὐσεβής, which see), [in LXX: Dan LXX Sus 1:64, 4Ma.9:6 אR, 4Ma.11:5 4Mac 11:8 4Mac 11:23 4Mac 18:2 * ;]
to reverence, show piety towards; with accusative (else­where more frequently before εἰς., περί, πρός): οἶκον, 1Tm 5:4; θεόν, At 17:23 (Cremer, 525).†
(AS)

G2152.def:
εὐσεβής, -ές
(εὖ, σέβομαι), [in LXX: Pv 12:12, Is 24:16 26:7 (צַדִּיק), Mq 7:2 (חָסִיד), Is 32:8 (נָדִיב), and frequently in Sirach and 4Maccabees ;]
pious, godly, devout: At 10:2, 7, 2Pe 2:9.†
SYN.: θεοσεβής, θρῆσκος (see Tr., Syn., § xlviii; DB, ii, 221 f.; Cremer, 524 f., 858) (AS)

G2154.def:
εὔσημος, -ον
(εὖ + οῆμα, a sign) [in LXX for כֶּסֶא, Sl 81:3 (-ως, from LXX 219)* ;]
__1. conspicuous (cf. Ps, l.with).
__2. clear to the understanding, distinct: 1Co 14:9.†
(AS)

G2155.def:
εὔσπλαγχνος, -ον
(εὖ, σπλάγχνον, which see), [in Man.1.7 (Camb. Manual LXX, iii, 825) ;]
__1. in Hippocr., as medical term (LS, see word).
__2. Metaphorical (cf. εὐσιλαγχνία, Eurip., Rhes., 192), in NT, tenderhearted, compassionate: Ef 4:32, 1Pe 3:8.†
(AS)

G2158.def:
εὐσχήμωι, -ον
(εὖ, σχῆμα), [in LXX: Pv 11:25 * ;]
__1. elegant, graceful, comely (Eur., Plat., al.): τὰ εὐ. ἡμῶν (opposite to τὰ ἀσχ- ἡμ-), 1Co 12:24; in moral sense, seemly, becoming, 1Co 7:35.
__2. Also in late Gk. (see Swete, Mk., l.with; MM, Exp., xiv), wealthy, influential (RV, of honourable estate): Mc 15:43, At 13:50 17:12.†
(AS)

G2159.def:
εὐτόνως
adv. (εὖ, τείνω), [in LXX forשׁוֹפָר Js 6:8 * ;]
vigorously, vehemently: Lc 23:10, At 18:28.†
(AS)

G2160.def:
εὐτραπελία, -ας, ἡ
(εὖ, τρέπω),
__1. versatility, wit, facetiousness (Hippocr., Plat., al.).
__2. = βωμολογία, coarse jesting, ribaldry (Abbott, Essays, 93): Ef 5:4.†
SYN.: μωρολογία, see Tr., Syn., § xxxiv (AS)

G2161.def:
Εὔτυχος, -ου, ὁ
(εὖ, τυχή),
Butychus, a young man: At 20:9.†
(AS)

G2162.def:
εὐφημία, -ας, ἡ
(εὔφημος), [in Sm.: Sl 42:5 47:2 100:2 126:2 * ;]
good report, praise: opposite to δυσφημία, 2Co 6:8.†
(AS)

G2163.def:
εὔφημος, -ον
(εὖ, φήμη), [in Sm.: Sl 63:6 ;]
primarily, utter­ing words or sounds of good omen, hence,
__1. avoiding ill-omened words, religiously silent.
__2. fair-sounding, auspicious (R, mg., gracious): Fp 4:8.†
(AS)

G2165.def:
εὐφραίνω
[in LXX chiefly for שָׂמַח, qal, pi. ;]
to cheer, gladden: with accusative of person(s), opposite to λυπεῖν, 2Co 2:2. Pass., to be happy, rejoice, make merry: Lc 15:32, At 2:26" (LXX) Rm 15:10 (LXX), Gl 4:27 (LXX), Ap 11:10 12:12; before ἐν, At 7:41; ἐπί with dative, Ap 18:20; of merry-making at a feast (3Ki.4:20; of. Kennedy, Sources, 155; Field, Notes, 69 f.), Lc 12:19 15:23-24, 29" (LXX) (λαμπρῶς) Lc 16:19.†
(AS)

G2167.def:
εὐφροσύνη, -ης, ἡ
(εὔφρων, cheerful) [in LXX chiefly for שִׂמְחָה ;]
rejoicing, gladness: At 2:28 (LXX) At 14:17.†
(AS)

G2168.def:
εὐχαριστέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Jdth.8:25 Wis.18:2, 2Ma.1:11 2Mac 10:7 A 2Ma.12:31 R, 3Ma.7:16 * ;]
to be thankful, give thanks (chiefly in late writers and Inscr.; cf. Milligan, Th., 5; Ellic. on Cl 1:12; Lft., Notes, 9): Rm 1:21, 1Co 14:17, 1Ts 5:18; of giving thanks before meat, Mt 15:36 26:27, Mc 8:6 14:23, Lc 22:17, 19, Jo 6:11, 23, 1Co 11:24; with dative pens., τ. θεῷ, Lc 17:16, At 27:35 28:15, Rm 14:6 16:4, 1Co 14:18, Fp 1:3, Cl 1:3, 12, Phm 4; before διὰ Ἰ. Χριστοῦ, Rm 1:8 7:25 R, WH, mg., Cl 3:17; ἐν ὀνόματι Χρ., Ef 5:20; before περί, 1Ts 1:2, 2Ts 1:3; ὅτι, Rm 1:8, 2Ts 2:13; ἐπι, with dative of thing(s), 1Co 1:4; ὐπέρ, 1Co 10:30, Ef 1:16 5:20; ὅτι, Lc 18:11, Jo 11:41, 1Co 1:14, 1Ts 2:13, Ap 11:17; pass. (Deiss., BS, 122 f.), 2Co 1:11.†
SYN.: see: αἰνέω; and cf. Cremer, 903 f (AS)

G2169.def:
εὐχαριστία, -ας, ἡ
(εὐχάριστος), [in LXX: Et 8:13, Wis.16:28, Sir.37:11, 2Ma.2:27 * ;]
__1. thankfulness, gratitude (Polyb.; Es, Sir, 2Mac, ll. with): At 24:3.
__2. giving of thanks, thanksgiving (so in π. and Inscr.; M, Th., 41 f.): 1Co 14:16, 2Co 4:15, Ef 5:4, Fp 4:6, Cl 2:7 4:2, 1Ts 3:9, 1Tm 4:3-4, Ap 4:9 7:12; with dative of person(s), 2Co 9:11 (cf. τ. θεοῦ, Wis, l.with); pl., 2Co 9:12, 1Tm 2:1 (Cremer, 904).†
(AS)

G2170.def:
εὐχάριστος, -ον
(εὖ, χαρίζομαι), [in LXX for חֵן, Pv 11:16 * ;]
__1. = εὔχαρις, winning, gracious, agreeable (Pr, l.with).
__2. grateful, thankful: Cl 3:15.†
(AS)

G2171.def:
εὐχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(εὔχομαι), [in LXX chiefly for נָדַר ;]
__1. a prayer: Tg 5:15.
__2. a vow: At 18:18 21:23.†
SYN.: see: δέησις (AS)

G2172.def:
εὔχομαι
[in LXX chiefly for נָדַד, also for עָתַר hi., etc. ;]
to pray: with accusative of thing(s), 2Co 13:9; with dative of person(s), τ. θεῷ, At 26:29; before πρὸς τ. θεόν, 2Co 13:7; with accusative and inf., At 27:29, 3Jn.2; before ὑπέρ, Tg 5:16; ηὐχόμην εἶναι (On imperfect here, see ICC, in l, Lft., Phm 13), Rm 9:3 (Cremer, 718).†
(AS)

G2173.def:
εὔ-χρηστος, -ον
(εὖ, χράομαι), [in LXX: Pv 31:13 (חֵפֶץ), Wis.13:13 * ;]
useful, serviceable: with dative of person(s), 2Tm 2:21; id. before εἰς, with dative of thing(s), 2Tm 4:11; opposite to ἄχρηστος, Phm 11.†
(AS)

G2174.def:
εὐψυχέω, -ῶ
(εὔψυχος, courageous),
to be of good courage: Fp 2:19.†
(AS)

G2175.def:
εὐωδία, -ας, ἡ
(εὐώδης, fragrant; ὄζω) [in LXX for נִיחוֹחַ, Gn 8:21, al. (ὀσμὴ εὐωδίας); Sir.20:9 24:15, al. ;]
fragrance: metaphorically, Χριστοῦ εὐ,., 2Co 2:15; ὀσμὴ εὐωδίας (a metaphor of sacrifice, most frequently in Pent. and Ez.), Ef 5:2, Fp 4:18.†
(AS)

G2176.def:
εὐώνυμος, -ον
(εὖ, ὄνομα), [in LXX chiefly for שְׂמֹאול ;]
__1. of good name or omen.
__2. Euphemistic for ἀριστερός, left: At 21:3, Ap 10:2; ἐξ εὐωνύμων, on the left: Mt 20:21, 23 25:33, 41 27:38, Mc 10:40 15:27.†
(AS)

G2177.def:
ἐφάλλομαι
[in LXX for צָלַח, 1Rs 10:6 11:6 16:13 * ;]
to leap upon: before ἐπί with accusative of person(s) At 19:16.†
(AS)

G2178.def:
ἐφ-άπαξ,
adv.
__1. once for all (Eupol.): Rm 6:10 Hb 7:27 9:12 10:10.
__2. at once: 1Co 15:6.†
(AS)

G2181.def:
Ἔφεσος, -ου, ἡ
Ephesus, a city in Asia Minor At 18:19, 21 18:24, 27 19:1, 17 19:26 (on the genitive, see M, Pr., 73) At 20:16-17, 1Co 15:32 16:8, Ef 1:1, 1Tm 1:3, 2Tm 1:18 4:12, Ap 1:11 2:1.†
(AS)

G2182.def:
ἐφ-ευρετής, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἐφευρίσκω, to find out)
an inventor, contriver: κακῶν (cf. κακίας εὑρετής, 2Ma.7:31), Rm 1:30.†
(AS)

G2183.def:
ἐφ-ημερία, -ας, ἡ
(ἐφήμερος), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁמֶרֶת, מַחֲלֹקֶת ;]
__1. a course of daily services (Ne 13:30, 1Cr 25:8, al.).
__2. a class or course of priests detailed for service in the temple (1Cr 23:6, al.): Lc 1:5, 8 (cf. MGr., ἐφημέριος, priest).†
(AS)

G2184.def:
ἐφ-ήμερος, -ον
(ἐπί, ἡμέρα),
__1. lasting for a day.
__2. daily, for the day: Tg 2:15.†
(AS)

G2185.def:
ἐφ-ικνέομαι, -οῦμαι
[in LXX: Sir.43:27, 30 R (ἀφικ- ABא)* ;]
to come to, to reach: before ἄχρι, 2Co 10:13; εἰς, 2Co 10:14.†
(AS)

G2186.def:
ἐφ-ίστημι
[in LXX for נָצַב ni., שִׁית, נָתַן, etc. ;]
__1. causal in pres., impf., fut., 1 aor., to set upon or by, set up, etc. (Æsch., Hdt., Arist., al).
__2. Intrans. in mid, and in pf. and 2 aor. act.;
__(a) to stand upon;
__(b) to be set over;
__(with) to stand by, be present, be at hand, come on or upon: Lc 2:38 10:40 20:1, At 6:12 12:7 22:13, 20 23:27, 2Tm 4:2; with dative pars., Lc 2:9 24:4, At 4:1 23:11; with dative bc., At 17:5; before έπί, with accusative, At 10:17 11:11; of rain, At 28:2; of evils impending, with dative of person(s), 1Ts 5:3; before έπί (Wis.6:9), Lc 21:34; of time, 2Tm 4:6 (cf. κατ-, συν-εφίστημι).†
(AS)

G2187.def:
Ἐφραίμ, (-ΐμ, Tr.)
Ephraim, a town near Jerusalem: Jo 11:54.†
(AS)

G2188.def:
ἐφφαθά (Aram. אֶתְפְּתח, see Abbott, Essays, 142 ff.; DCG, i, 522)
ephphatha, be opened: Mc 7:34.†
(AS)

G2189.def:
ἔχθρα, -ας, ἡ
(ἐχθρός), [in LXX for אֵיבָה, שִׂנְאָה, etc. ;]
enmity: Lc 23:12, Rm 8:7, Gl 5:20, Ef 2:15-16, Tg 4:4.†
ἀηδία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀ- neg., ἦδος, pleasure), [in LXX: Pv 23:29 (שִׂיחַ)* ;]
__1. of things or persons, unpleasantness, odiousness (Hipp., Dem., al.)
__2. dislike (Plat.). disagreement (MM, VGT, see word): Lc 23:12 D.†
(AS)

G2190.def:
ἐχθρός, -ά, -όν
(ἔχθος, hatred), [in LXX chiefly for אֵיבָה, also for עָר, etc. ;]
__1. hated, hateful (Hom.): opposite to ἀγαπητός, Rm 11:28.
__2. Actively, hating, hostile: Rm 5:10, 1Co 15:25, 2Ts 3:15; with genitive of person(s) (cl.), Tg 4:4; τ. διανοίᾳ, Cl 1:21; ἐ. ἄνθρωπος, Mt 13:28; as subst., ὁ ἐ., an enemy, 1Co 15:26; the devil, Mt 13:39, Lc 10:19; with genitive of person(s), Mt 22:44 Mc 12:36, Lc 20:43, At 2:35, 1Co 15:25, Hb 1:13 10:13" (LXX) ; Mt 5:43-44 10:36 13:25, Lc 1:71, 74 6:27, 35 19:27, 43, Rm 12:20, Gl 4:16, Ap 11:5, 12; with genitive of thing(s), At 13:10, Fp 3:18.†
(AS)

G2191.def:
ἔχιδνα, -ης, ἡ
[in OT (Aq.), Is 59:5 * ;]
a viper: At 28:3; metaphorically, γεννήματα ἐχιδνῶν, Mt 3:7 12:34 23:33, Lc 3:7.†
(AS)

G2192.def:
ἔχω,
[in LXX for אָצֵל (ἐχόμενος), יֵשׁ,בַּעַל, etc., 59 words in all ;]
(on the Aktionsart of the various tenses, see M, Pr., 110, 145, 150, 183), to have, as in cl., in various senses and constructions.
__I. Trans.;
__1. 1. to have, hold, hold fast, etc.;
__(a) to hold, as, in the hand: Ap 5:8 14:6, al.; ἐν τ. χειρί, Ap 1:16 10:2, al.;
__(b) of arms and clothing, = φέρω, φορέω, to bear, wear: Mt 3:4 22:12, al.; so frequently present ptcp. (LS, see word, A, I, 6; Bl., 74, 2), Mc 11:13, Jo 18:10, Ap 9:17, al.;
__(with) of a woman, ἐν γαστρὶ ἔ, to be with child: Mc 13:17, Rm 9:10;
__(d) to hold fast, keep: Lc 19:20; metaphorically, of the mind and conduct, Mc 16:8 (cf. Jó 21:6, Is 13:8; Deiss., BS, 293; Field, Notes, 44f.), Jo 14:21, Rm 1:28, 1Tm 3:9, 2Tm 1:13, Ap 6:9, al.;
__(e) to involve: Hb 10:35 (LXX), Tg 1:4, 1Jo 4:18; (f) = Lat. habere (Bl., §34, 5; 73, 5), to hold, consider: with accusative and predic. ptcp., Lc 14:18; with accusative, before ὡς, Mt 14:5; εἰς (Hebraism), Mt 21:46; on (Bl., §70, 2), Mc 11:32.
__2. to have, possess;
__(a) in general, with accusative of thing(s): Mt 19:22, Mc 10:22, Lc 12:19, Jo 10:16, 1Co 11:22, al.; of wealth or poverty, absol., ἔχειν (neg. οὐκ, μή), Mt 13:12 25:29, 2Co 8:12; ἐκ τ. ἔχειν, according to your means, 2Co 8:11;
__(b) of relationship, association, and: πατέρα, Jo 8:41; γυναῖκα (MM, xiv), 1Co 7:2; φίλον, Lc 11:5; βασιλέα, Jo 19:15; ποιμένα, Mt 9:36; with dupl. accusative, Mt 3:9, al.;
__(with) of parts or members: ὦτα, Mt 19:15; μέλη, Rm 12:4; θεμελίους,
__(d) with accusative, as periphrasis of verb: μνεῖαν ἔ. (= μεμνῆσθαι), 1Ts 3:6; ἀγάπην, Jo 13:35; γνῶσιν, 1Co 8:1; πεποίθησιν, 2Co 3:4; θλίψιν, Jo 16:33, etc. (Thayer, see word, I, 2, f., g.);
__(e) of duty, necessity, etc.: ἀνάγκην, 1Co 7:37; νόμον, Jo 19:7; ἐπιταγήν, 1Co 7:25; ἀγῶνα, Fp 1:30; κρίμα, 1Tm 5:12;
__(f) of complaints and disputes; κατά, with genitive of person(s), Mt 5:23, Mc 11:25; id. before ὅτι, Ap 2:4, 20; with accusative before πρός, At 24:19, al.;
__(g) with inf.,
__(α) (cl.) to be able (Field, Notes, 14): Mt 18:25, Mc 14:8 (sc. ποιῆσαι), Lc 12:4, At 4:14, al;
__(β) of necessity (BL, §69, 4): Lc 12:50, At 23:17-19 28:19.
__II. Intrans. (BL, §53, 1), to be in a certain condition: ἑτοίμως ἔ., with inf., At 21:13, 2Co 12:14; ἐσχάτως (which see), Mc 5:23; κακῶς, to be ill, Mt 4:24, al.; καλῶς, Mk 16:[18]; κομψότερον, Jo 4:52; πῶς, At 15:36; impers., ἄλλως εἴχει, it is otherwise, 1Tm 5:25; οὕτως, At 7:1, al.; τὸ νῦν ἔχον, as things now are (Tob.7:11), At 24:25.
__III. Mid., -ομαι, to hold oneself fast, hold on or cling to, be next to: with genitive, τ. ἐχόμενα σωτηρίας, Hb 6:9 (Rendall, in l.); ptcp., ὁ ἐχόμενος, near, next: of place, Mc 1:38; of time, τ. ἐχομένη (ἡμέρα, expressed or understood), Lc 13:33, At 20:15 21:26; (σαββάτῳ), At 13:44. (Cf. ἀν-, προσ-αν-, ἀντ-, ἀπ-, ἐν-, ἐπ-, κατ-, μετ-, παρ-, περι-, προ-, προσ-, συν-, ὑπερ-, ὑπ-έχω.)
(AS)

G2193.def:
ἕως,
relative particle (Lat. donee, usque),
expressing the terminus ad quem (cf. Burton, §321ff.).
__I. As conjunction;
__1. till, until;
__(a) of a fact in past time, with indic.: Mt 2:9, al. (Wis.10:14, al.);
__(b) ἕως ἄν, with subjc. aor.: Mt 2:13 5:18, Mc 6:10, al.; without ἄν (M. Pr., 168f.; Lft., Notes, 115), Mc 14:32 (Burton, §325), Lc 12:59, 2Ts 2:7, al.;
__(with) with indic., present (Burton, §328; BL, §65, 10): Mc 6:45, Jo 21:22, 23 1Tm 4:13.
__2. C. indic., as long as, while (Burton, §327): Jo 9:4 (Plat., Phaedo, 89c).
__II. As an adverb (chiefly in late writers).
__1. Of time, until, unto;
__(a) as prep. with genitive (BL, §40, 6; M, Pr., 99): τ. ἡμέρας, Mt 26:29, Lc 1:80, Rm 11:8, al.; ὥρας, Mt 27:45, al.; τέλους, 1Co 1:8, 2Co 1:13; τ. νῦν, Mt 24:21, Mc 13:19 (1Ma.2:33); ἐτῶν ὀγ. (Field, Notes, 49f.), Lc 2:37; τ. ἐλθεῖν, At 8:40; before names and events, Mt 1:17 2:15, Lc 11:51, Tg 5:7, al.;
__(b) before οὗ, ὅτου, with the force of a conjc. (Burton, §330; M, Pr., 91);
__(α) ἕ. οὗ (Hdt., ii, 143; Plut., al.): with indic., Mt 1:25 (WH br., οὗ) 13:33, al.; with subjc. aor., Mt 14:22, al.;
__(β) ἔ. ὅτου: with subjc., Lc 13:8; with indic., Mt 5:25 (until), Jo 9:18;
__(with) with adv. (ἔ. ὀψέ, Thuc, iii, 108): ἄρτι, Mt 11:12, Jo 2:10, 1Co 4:13, al.; πότε (M, Pr., 107), Mt 17:17, Mc 9:19, Jo 10:24, al.
__2. Of place, as far as, even to, unto (Arist., al.);
__(a) as prep. with genitive (see supr.): Mt 1123, Lk 1015, al.;
__(b) with adv. (BL, §40, 6): ἄνω, Jo 2:7; ἔσω, Mc 14:54; κάτω, Mt 27:51, Mc 15:38; ὧδε, Lc 23:5;
__(with) with prep.: ἔξω, At 21:5; πρός, Lc 24:50 (Field, Notes, 83).
__3. Of quantity, measure, etc.: Mt 18:21, Mc 6:23, Lc 22:51, al.
(AS)

G2194.def:
Ζαβουλών, ὁ indecl. (Heb. זְבוּלוּן see Gn 30:20)
Zebulun, Jacob's tenth son: the tribe of Z., Mt 4:13, 15, Ap 7:8.†
(AS)

G2195.def:
Ζακχαῖος, -ου, ὁ (Heb. זַכַּי, cf. Ne 7:14, I Et 2:9, LXX Ζακχού),
Zaccai, Zacchaeus, a publican: Lc 19:2, 5 19:8 (cf. 2Ma.10:19).†
(AS)

G2196.def:
Ζαρά, ὁ indecl. (Heb. זֶרַח, Gn 38:30),
Zerah, an ancestor of Jesus: Mt 1:3.†
(AS)

G2197G.def:
Ζαχαρίας, -ου, ὁ (Heb. זַכַּי);
__1. Zacharias, father of John the Baptist: Lc 1:5, 12-13 1:18, 21 1:40, 59 1:67 3:2.
__2. Zechariah, the son of Jehoiada (in txt. wrongly called son of Barachiah; cf. 2Cr 24:19 ff.): Mt 23:35, Lc 11:51.†
(AS)

G2197H.def:
Ζαχαρίας, -ου, ὁ (Heb. זַכַּי);
__1. Zacharias, father of John the Baptist: Lc 1:5, 12-13 1:18, 21 1:40, 59 1:67 3:2.
__2. Zechariah, the son of Jehoiada (in txt. wrongly called son of Barachiah; cf. 2Cr 24:19 ff.): Mt 23:35, Lc 11:51.†
(AS)

G2198.def:
ζάω, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for חיה (most frequently ptcp., ζῶν, inf., ζῆν, for חַי ;]
__1. prop., to live, be alive (see Syn., see word βίος; in cl. usually of animal life, but sometimes of plants, as Arist., Eth. N, i, 7, 12): At 20:12, Rm 7:1-3, 1Co 7:39, Ap 19:20, al.; ἐν αὐτῷ ζῶμεν, At 17:28; ἐμοὶ τὸ ζῆν Χριστός, Fp 1:21; διὰ παντὸς τοῦ ζῆν (M, Pr., 215, 249), Hb 2:15; ὃ δὲ νῦν ζῶ ἐν σαρκί, Gl 2:20; ζῇ ἐν ἐμοὶ Χριστός, Gl 2:20; (ὁ) ζῶν, of God (אֵל חַי and cognate phrases, Js 3:10, Os 2:1 (1:10), Is 37:4, al.; see DCG, ii, 39a), Mt 16:16, Jo 6:57, Rm 9:26, 1Ts 1:9, Hb 3:12, Ap 7:2, al.; in juristic phrase, ζῶ ἐγώ (חַי־אָנִי, Nm 14:21, al.), as I live, Rm 14:11; ζῆν ἐπ᾽ ἄρτῳ, Mt 4:4, al.; ἐκ, 1Co 9:14; of coming to life, Mrk.16:[11], Rm 6:10 14:9, 2Co 13:4; opposite to νεκρός, Ap 1:18 2:8; metaphorically, Lc 15:32; ζῆν ἐκ νεκρῶν, Rm 6:13; of the spiritual life of Christians, Lc 10:28, Jo 5:25, Rm 1:17 8:13; εἰς τ. αἰῶνα, Jo 6:51, 58; σὺν Χριστῷ, 1Ts 5:10; ὄνομα ἔχεις ὅτι ζῇς, Ap 3:1.
__2. As sometimes in cl., = βιόω, to live, pass one's life: Lc 2:36, At 26:5, Rm 7:9, Cl 2:20; ἐν πίστει, Gl 2:20; ἐν τ. ἁμαρτίᾳ, Rm 6:2; εὐσεβῶς, 2Tm 3:12; ἀσώτως, Lc 15:13; with dative (cl.), ἑαυτῳ (Field, Notes, 164), Rm 14:7, 2Co 5:15; τ. δικαιοσύνῃ, Lc 20:38, Rm 6:10, 11 Gl 2:19; τ. Χριστῷ, 2Co 5:15; τ. θεῷ, 1Pe 2:24; πνεύματι, Gl 5:25; κατὰ σάρκα, Rm 8:12, 13;
__3. Of inanimate things, metaphorically: ὕδωρ ζῶν (i.e. springing water, as opposite to still water), in a spiritual sense, Jo 4:10, 11 7:38 (DCG, ii, 39f.): ἐλπὶς ζῶσα, 1Pe 1:3; ὁδὸς ζῶσα, Hb 10:20 (cf. ἀνα-, συν-ζάω; Cremer, 270, 721).
(AS)

G2199G.def:
Ζεβεδαῖος, -ου, ὁ (Heb. זְבַדְיָה; LXX: Ζαβδειά, Et 8:8 10:20; Ζαβαδαῖας, I Et 9:35; Ζαβαδαῖος, I Et 9:21)
Zebedee, father of James and John the Apostles: Mt 4:21 10:2 20:20 26:37 27:56, Mc 1:19-20 3:17 10:35, Lc 5:10, Jo 21:2.†
(AS)
